categories.title: Compatibility
list: Updated for Blockbench 5.0

categories.title: New Features
list: Added a two colour mode that generates the gradient between two selected colours
Added a "Hue Path" slider to the two colour mode to control the route the blend takes around or across the colour wheel
Added a "Bias" slider to the two colour mode to cluster the shades towards one colour or the other
Added a "Lightness Curve" slider to the two colour mode to bow the blend through darker or lighter midtones
Added a new "Curve" slider to bias the gradient towards lighter or darker tones
Added a new "Saturation Falloff" slider to reduce saturation toward the lightest and darkest colours
Added an advanced preview mode that graphs the palette in the saturation/lightness plane
The two colour advanced preview also shows the blend's route on a colour wheel

categories.title: Changes
list: Redesigned the dialog with a more compact two column layout
Reworked the palette maths so the lightness follows one smooth curve with no kink at the base colour
The colour offset now repositions the base colour without changing the gradient curve
The brightness range is now a percentage
